basic_info.name: Atomic
basic_info.description: WELCOME TO SKIINGAtomic was born in the Austrian Alps in 1955. Founder Alois Rohrmoser handcarved race skis that would give an edge to the most successful athletes of that era. The brand’s modern-day headquarters are still located in the Pongau Valley, just five kilometers from Rohrmoser’s original workshop. This history and heritage continue to be the foundation of Atomic’s identity, from the early days of handmade wooden skis to the skis that grace the tops of World Cup podiums and remote peaks around the world today. SKIED AROUND THE WORLDThe manufacturer designs and produces skis used by some of the top skiers in the world across every discipline. From World-Cup racing to the X-Games, Nordic to Ski-mountaineering to the most demanding backcountry-skiing objectives, skiers like Mikaela Shiffrin, Hermann Maier, and Chris Bentchetler have all trusted their careers to Atomic. In turn, these and many other elite skiers provide feedback from the highest levels of competition and performance to help guide R&D and innovation at Atomic, thereby shaping and guiding the focus of the brand.WE ARE SKIINGToday Atomic employs around 1000 people at their Pongau Valley headquarters. Here, they produce over 400,000 pairs of skis each year. For more than 65 years the brand has been synonymous with skiing, and each member of the Atomic family continues to contribute to that identity. From R&D to marketing professionals, to pro athletes and the craftsmen who leave the finishing touches on each product, each person lives and breathes the sport of skiing. Atomic is a company founded by a skier, and continues to be a brand for skiers, by skiers.

basic_info.description: ATOMIC is a fintech startup.ATOMIC was founded by veteran entrepreneurs with diverse expertise in software engineering, high-performance core system design, fintech, product design, blockchain infrastructure, cryptography, and algo-trading. ATOMIC develops a clearing service for cryptocurrencies, guaranteed by collateral. The system is encrypted, secured, non-custodial and provides instant payment approval. The system provides multi-currency clearing services for individuals and financial institutions, while protecting against fraud and partially-executed deals.We are near the completion of a P2P exchange service development, that demonstrates the power of the clearing service on which it was built.Our vision is to enable leading financial institutions to join the blockchain revolution. Services for retail payments, e-commerce payments, crypto-backed loans, exchange credit-lines, coins exchange, credit history services and more, can all be easily based on the strong and flexible clearing service offered by ATOMIC.For news and updates, join us on Telegram https://t.me/AtomicOrgTo contact us, email contact@atomic.org
